betterpets-quickslots.settings.title: Pet Quickslots - Settings
betterpets-quickslots.settings.key.hint: Click: press a new key. Right-click or Esc: clear it.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.keys.pres: The pet wheel on R, plus: hold Left Alt and press 1-9 or turn the mouse wheel. Works on every keyboard and takes no key away from the game.
Adds direct keys on the numeric keypad: 1-9 for the slots, + and - for next and previous, 0 to put the pet away.
Just the pet wheel on R. Every other key of the mod is cleared.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.keys.whee: Hold the key, point the mouse at a pet, let go. Your quickslots sit around the cursor.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.keys.modi: While you hold it, the number keys and the mouse wheel work your quickslots instead of the hotbar.
Hold the modifier key and press a hotbar key: summons the pet of that slot. Without the modifier the hotbar keys do what they always do.
Hold the modifier key and turn the mouse wheel: goes to the next or previous pet.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.keys.slot: A key of its own for quickslot %s. Not needed if you use the wheel or the modifier key.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.keys.next: Summons the pet of the next filled quickslot.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.keys.prev: Summons the pet of the previous filled quickslot.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.keys.put_: Puts away the pet that is out.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.keys.open: Opens the screen where you choose the pets for your quickslots.
Opens this screen from the game.
Opens the server's pet menu, as typing /pets does.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.display.s: Bar: all slots in a row. Ring: the slots in a circle, the pet that is out in the middle. Compact: only the pet that is out. Off: nothing.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.display.o: Shows the display for a moment whenever another pet comes out or yours is put away.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.display.s: How long the display stays after the pet changed.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.display.w: Shows the slots for as long as you hold the modifier key - so you see where the numbers and the mouse wheel will take you.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.display.a: Keeps the display on screen all the time.
The edge or corner of the screen the display sits at.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.display.o: Moves the display left or right, in pixels. Easier: open the full-size preview and drag it there.
Moves the display up or down, in pixels. Easier: open the full-size preview and drag it there.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.display.s: How large the display is. Right-click sets it back to 100%%.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.display.o: Lower values let the world show through the display.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.display.n: Writes the name of the pet that is out next to the slots.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.display.k: Shows under every slot how you reach it from the keyboard.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.display.e: Off: slots without a pet are left out and the display gets shorter.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.wheel.hol: On: hold the key, point at a pet, let go. Off: the key opens the wheel and a click chooses. A short tap of the key leaves the wheel open either way.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.wheel.sca: How large the wheel is. It never gets larger than the screen.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.wheel.not: Only the direction of the mouse counts - you do not have to hit the pet. Letting go in the middle changes nothing. The keys 1-9 choose a slot directly while the wheel is open.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.look.head: Look and feel
betterpets-quickslots.settings.look.anim: Off: everything appears at once, without any movement.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.look.deco: The little pets leaning on the menus, and the sparkle on their corners.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.look.soun: The clicks of the mod's own menus.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.look.spam: The server limits how quickly pets can be switched. The mod therefore sends nothing the server would turn down anyway: a held key switches once, and during a wait the display shows the countdown instead.
This server: %s s between two switches.
betterpets-quickslots.settings.preview.h: Drag to move the display - the mouse wheel changes its size
Point at a pet and click - the mouse wheel changes the size
betterpets-quickslots.settings.preview.t: Press your keys - this shows what they do.
%s held: now 1-9 or the mouse wheel
